title: Chris Kelly's double-booking and the decline of his band
summary: Humphrey criticizes Chris Kelly for sending substitutes to dates and how other bands competed for his work.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Chris Kelly, the blues trumpeter and his band
